title: Editor randomly crashes on Ubuntu Wayland with signal 11
body:
### Tested versions

Godot Engine v4.6.2.stable.official.71f334935

### System information

Godot v4.6.2.stable - Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS 24.04 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (RPL-U) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-1335U (12 threads) - 15.32 GiB memory

### Issue description

### Steps to reproduce

I cannot reproduce it reliably, it is seemingly random. Sometimes it happens when I open a scene, or when I connect a signal, or when I rename a node.
I don't remember having these issues as soon as I upgraded to 4.6.2, it started only a couple weeks ago so maybe this has to do with some recent Ubuntu update.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A The issue is with the editor.
